ENDEES

Game privacy

Updated: 12 October 2026

Scope and operator

This policy covers Happy Octo Puzzle published by Appmonto Studio, for children aged 3–8. The legal operator is unchanged and is identified in the imprint. Clever Beaver and Closer Look: Farm are in development; their release-specific disclosures will be published before launch.

Gameplay and children’s privacy

Happy Octo Puzzle does not require an account and does not collect personal information through gameplay. It does not use advertising, analytics or behavioural profiles. It does not access contacts, location, camera or microphone.

Offline play

Happy Octo Puzzle’s puzzles work offline. Downloading the app and using Google Play services are separate from core gameplay and may require a connection.

Store services and planned purchases

Google Play processes information under its own terms and privacy policy when you use the store. In-app purchases are planned for Closer Look: Farm. Store billing and purchase restoration may process transaction information and require a connection. This does not mean advertising or behavioural tracking is included in the game. Details specific to the released purchasing implementation will be provided before launch.

Support correspondence

If you email us, your address and message are processed to answer your request and kept only as long as needed for that purpose. Please do not send personal information about children. Support correspondence is separate from gameplay.

Security

Offline gameplay limits the information sent from the app. No service can guarantee the absence of all security risks; avoid including unnecessary personal information in support requests.

Your rights and contact

You can contact support@appmonto.com about access, correction or deletion of your support correspondence. The studio website privacy notice explains the operator, hosting and applicable privacy rights.

Changes

Changes to this policy will be published here with an updated date.
